trials_for_all_success — SPC pod op

• Data kinds: none → scalar (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.trials_for_all_success(p_min, *, confidence=0.95) (to call the implementation directly, import pod; pod.trials_for_all_success(p_min, *, confidence=0.95); from the registry, opsspc.get("trials_for_all_success"))

Usage

Return the minimum trial count needed for all successes to establish p >= p_min at one-sided confidence (scalar).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値は整数で、Clopper--Pearson の全数成功時の閉形式 (1-confidence)**(1/n) >= p_min に基づく。たとえば POD >= 0.90 を 95 % 信頼で示すには 29/29 が必要である。誤警報率 p <= p_max を 0 件で示す件数は trials_for_all_success(1-p_max, confidence=...) と同じ。

拒否(ValueError): p_min または confidence が有限な (0, 1) 外。
